# Mohamed Sameer

> Senior Product Manager specializing in fintech, payments, and AI products. Based in Cairo, Egypt; serving clients across Egypt, MENA, the GCC (GCC), and remotely worldwide. Available for large-budget projects and consulting.

## Who he is
Mohamed Sameer is a senior product manager with 14 years in technology and 4 years in banking and fintech (payments, wallets, cards, and digital lending). He translates complex banking and regulatory requirements into clear, usable products that ship and create measurable value. He works across the full product lifecycle: discovery, BRDs and requirements, roadmapping, delivery, launch, and growth.

## What he does (services)
- Product strategy & roadmapping — outcome-based prioritization and release planning.
- Fintech & payments product leadership — wallets, cards, digital lending, bill payment, merchant products, and integrations.
- AI product development — concept to validated, shippable scope.
- Discovery & requirements — BRDs, user stories, user flows, acceptance criteria.
- MVP definition & launch — de-risked MVPs, validated discovery, go-to-market plans.
- Growth & analytics — funnel audits, instrumentation, and experiment backlogs.

## Selected results
- Doubled conversion rates across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Egypt on fintech and SaaS products.
- Scaled a fintech product suite (digital lending, bill payment, merchant products) from requirements to launch — 3 products.
- Founded and grew an Arabic crypto-content platform to ~10,000 monthly readers.
- 60% year-over-year growth on under 30% of the prior budget; $50K B2B revenue in year one.
- Millions of organic views from a livestreaming launch.
- $8M+ in new opportunities identified.
